text: vii In compiling a book like Encyclopedia of Gods, one is struck both by the enormous number and vari- ety of deities that occur in different religions around the world, and also by the way patterns repeat themselves—almost every culture has its creator gods, gods concerned with a locally impor- tant aspect of the weather, goddesses of fertility, gods whose duty it is to protect the home.

vii
In compiling a book like Encyclopedia of Gods, one
is struck both by the enormous number and vari-
ety of deities that occur in different religions
around the world, and also by the way patterns
repeat themselves—almost every culture has its
creator gods, gods concerned with a locally impor-
tant aspect of the weather, goddesses of fertility,
gods whose duty it is to protect the home.
